newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges rates quoted mostly flat to higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges rates quoted mostly flat to higher.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady to higher levels on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange. No barges traded versus six barges traded Thursday.
- Two barges, this week, St. Louis (Mississippi) bid 100 percent of tariff, no offer.
- One barge, next week, St. Louis (Mississippi) bid 95 percent, no offer.
- Eight barges, two each week of January, Lower Ohio River, offered at 127-1/2 percent, up 2-1/2 points from previous day, no bid.
- Eight barges, two each week January, St. Louis (Mississippi), offered at 115 percent, no bid.
There will be no call sessions on Tuesday Dec. 24 and 25 or 31, or January 1, the exchange said.
